messages.subject: EGCO Group | POWER4, clean-energy growth and regional stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Sumranwanich and EGCO Group Leadership Team,

EGCO Group's 2026 POWER4 strategy, clean-energy investment program and focus on resilience in the face of geopolitical and regulatory change make the company highly relevant to my background.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring practical energy-transition experience through governance and stakeholder work around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, plus carbon-data readiness from operating records. I also lead multi-agency engagement and cross-functional execution on regulated, community-sensitive and reputation-sensitive matters. This combination would support EGCO's regional growth where project delivery depends on trusted institutions and disciplined internal follow-through.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or international mandates in External Affairs, ESG, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations or regional country leadership. I have attached an EGCO-focused executive CV and would appreciate your routing it to the relevant executive team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
